reviews.title: I was with Lebara up until 25 September…
reviews.body:
I was with Lebara up until 25 September when I switched to 1D mobile and ported over my number. BIG MISTAKE!
After two days and no signal (4G) I went back to Lebara and requested to port back my number from 1D. I received a new SIM card from Lebara on 30 September and requested them to port back my number from 1D. This was completed on 30 September but I have not been able to make or receive any phone calls as I have no network.
I have contacted Lebara chat line with an agent ( I have spoken with 4 different agents about the same problem) and it has still not been resolved. I telephoned and spoke to Meenakshi and went through the whole scenario again and been advised that a ticket will be raised about the problem which could take between 24 to 48 hours to resolve. I have asked for compensation for the problem that I cannot make or receive calls. This Lebara service is in India and is absolutely appalling. I am a vulnerable person and need access to mobile phone which I explained to all of the advisers. I await a response!!I didn’t have a problem when Lebara was with Vodaphone!!!

reviews.title: common sense left this company
reviews.body:
They ask for your email address, but if you simply wait, they eventually pass you through anyway.

Then they ask for the last number you called. You give them their own number, and somehow that also passes "security".

What is the point of asking these security questions if they do not actually verify anything?

There are also complaints that have been handled completely out of order. The network coverage is very poor, and I am currently waiting for a deadlock letter so that I can take the matter to the Ombudsman.

They also say one thing over the phone and something completely different in writing. When challenged, they cannot even agree on which version is correct.

And this is only touching the surface. The full story is much more serious.

For example, my eSIM was activated, and I received a text message confirming the number. The following day, however, I was told that the eSIM had not been activated.

This kind of contradictory information and poor handling makes it extremely difficult to resolve even straightforward issues.

Requested SAR, requested deadlock letter, Ombudsman will be very interested to look into it...
